READY-TO-IMPLEMENT DESIGN (verified against the code read; all in scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.mjs + one new helper):
(a) observePipelineStartPreflight (options at :1030-1061; early governance return :1073-1093 stays untouched) gains options role (default 'elephant'; anything except 'goldfish'/'critic' = elephant, Ruling 67) and runModelRoleBootstrapFn (default undefined).
(b) After :1548-1550 (cloneProvisioning, mandatoryHookReadiness, resultStatus): staleMandatory = mandatoryHookReadiness.refreshAvailable non-empty (when readiness.status==='ready') OR readiness.required entries with status 'refresh' (when blocked / HOOK-READINESS-STATE-UNSUPPORTED, the stale+missing mix of test 3). Enforce only when role is elephant AND base status === 'ready' (same precondition as applyMandatoryHookGate) AND (readiness ready OR blocked with that exact code); OWNER-OR-DECLINE and unresolved stay null (human decision). refreshes = cloneProvisioning.checks ids with status 'refresh' sorted (test 1 expects pre-push INCLUDED: [commit-msg, pre-commit, pre-push]; test 3 only needs pre-commit included). Readiness ready -> new status 'hook-refresh-required' (not in the exit allowlist at :1709 so exit 2 automatically; status string unpinned); blocked mix -> status stays hook-provisioning-blocked.
(c) refreshAction = { kind:'command', executable: process.execPath, argv:[resolve(pluginRoot,'scripts/refresh-mandatory-hooks.mjs'),'--root',resolve(cwd)], mutation:true, requiresConfirmation:true (mirrors :1576; unpinned), executionBoundary, expected:{schema:'pipeline.mandatory-hook-refresh.v1', status:'ready'}, refreshes }. Chain at :1570-1581 becomes: hook-provisioning-required (unchanged) -> hook-refresh-required ? refreshAction -> hook-provisioning-blocked ? (refreshAction ?? null) -> rest unchanged. Test asserts argv[0] absolute and under join(result.pluginRoot,'scripts')+sep: satisfied because pluginRoot derives from scriptUrl.
(d) CONDITIONAL THENABLE (Ruling 69): keep building the envelope synchronously exactly as today (final return :1670-1678). Only if runModelRoleBootstrapFn is a function: call it once with { rootDir: resolve(cwd), runner, env } in try/catch (sync throw -> { status:'unavailable', code:'MODEL-ROLE-BOOTSTRAP-UNAVAILABLE' }); define attach(v) = { ...envelope, modelRoleBootstrap:{ status: v?.status==='ready'?'ready':'unavailable', code: typeof v?.code==='string'?v.code:'MODEL-ROLE-BOOTSTRAP-UNAVAILABLE' } }; if v is thenable return v.then(attach, ()=>attach(unavailable)) else return attach(v). No seam -> no field and a plain object (all sync callers and the pinned key set byte-identical). Attach AFTER bootstrapPayload is computed (it measures `result`, so budget unchanged).
(e) main() (:1896): accept options.modelRoleBootstrap; when !== undefined call observePipelineStartPreflight({ runModelRoleBootstrapFn: () => options.modelRoleBootstrap }) (plain-value seam, main stays sync); otherwise the identical zero-arg call. runEntry (:1940) additionally: check observeGovernanceScope({ rootDir: process.cwd() }).state === 'active' first, then await (await import('./model-role-bootstrap.mjs')).runModelRoleBootstrap({ rootDir: process.cwd(), runner: resolveActiveRunner(), env: process.env }) in try/catch (throw -> unavailable marker), pass it as modelRoleBootstrap. Open question for the dispatcher: is running the real bootstrap on every preflight acceptable (it may touch the host store; confirm=null so no prompt)? The T0 header says a required readback, so yes unless told otherwise.
(f) NEW scripts/refresh-mandatory-hooks.mjs: CLI --root <repo>. For each of pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push: plan = planInstall({ rootDir }) from the hook's installer (planInstall exports verified for pre-commit :865; commit-msg and pre-push imported as planInstall in check-clone-provisioning.mjs:15-17; applyInstall exported by pre-commit :925 and commit-msg (imported in clone-hook-readiness.mjs:9); pre-push applyInstall NOT verified). Apply ONLY when plan.status==='ready-to-upgrade' && plan.updateRequired===true; every other status (ready=missing, declined, foreign-hook-present, ...) is skipped and reported, never applied: applyInstall re-plans internally and would also install over 'declined' / 'ready', so this pre-filter is the only guard. Print one JSON line { schema:'pipeline.mandatory-hook-refresh.v1', status, results:[{id,status}], readiness } with readiness = assessMandatoryHookReadiness(checkCloneProvisioning(root)); exit 0 when the mandatory readiness is ready, else 2. Use isDirectInvocation from ../lib/entrypoint.mjs like clone-hook-readiness.mjs.
